text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Flash-san! May you have a 
wonderful year♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your thoughtfulness. I see 
each of you prepared something for me.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's right. I prepared two with 
the exact same wrapping— and shuffled them 
just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
One of them is a crazy bomb—a present with 
a pungent stench that won't wash off in a 
single day!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Flash...! Which one will you 
choose! Double or nothing, test your luck!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Waah, to think you had a surprise like 
this planned...! I had no idea at all!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? You're the one who came to me 
saying your present might be too ordinary, 
aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You'd better be ready for some extra 
spice.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I-I see. Brace myself, brace myself...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Thank you very much, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Since you went through the trouble, I will 
gladly accept. Both the spice and the 
present, down to the very last bit.
